notes: Dialogue between Jin Cheonhee and Yeo Halyun uses huynh/đệ where context supports sworn-brother speech.
Narration is compressed for speech-bubble readability without dropping combat logic.

Public references confirmed English character and martial-art naming, but no sufficiently reliable public Vietnamese glossary was found; Vietnamese martial terms are therefore localized consistently in Sino-Vietnamese style rather than copied from an unverified fan translation.
